ruling.recommended_action: Refund the metered overcharge for the unexempt off-route segment as Ryde voucher; retain the $1.08 waiting time (meter waiting unit) — do not add + flag_account.

segment_findings.reason: RD-1: off-route segment 17:37–17:50 adds 3.17 km (5.85 km vs 2.68 km optimal), well beyond matching noise. Not exempt under RD-4: F15 shows no traffic incident and F13/F14 are speed-band facts only (RD-4(b), G3). Not exempt under RD-3: rider named no place for the 7-Eleven [F9] and the driver picked an off-route one without telling the rider beforehand [F12], so the extra km exceeds the consent to 'a stop' (RD-3(b)); no pre-detour rider consent message exists (RD-5, G11).

RD-3(c): the ~4 min stationary stop is part of the rider-requested stop accepted by the driver [F9][F10]; on RydeTAXI the stop duration is metered waiting time and is chargeable (F6), so the $1.08 waiting fee is not refunded — only the segment's extra mileage is.

rejected_claims.reason: Driver's post-trip claim that the rider asked for the stop is a claim, not consent to the routing; under G11/RD-5 only a rider message sent before the detour counts, and the chat shows the rider named no location, so the driver's chosen off-route 7-Eleven is not exempted (RD-3(b)).
PIE speed band 4 during the window does not show congestion on the replaced optimal-route stretch; band 4 is also not band 1–2, and a band fact alone cannot exempt a segment (RD-4(b), G3).
Same as F13 for the Central Expressway; no incident corroboration (F15), so no RD-4 exemption.
